# v0.9.1 — Clearer charging activity

- Charging activity explains what ran, when, why and which function triggered it in HA and the app.
- Plug & Charge uses fresh readings to preserve a running current instead of restoring an old pause setpoint.
- Charging status now explains brief transitions, missing readings and persistent ambiguity.
- Repeated identical current commands create less HA activity; updated guides explain the timeline, dashboard and history settings.

Update the app to **0.9.1** before updating the integration.
